layout_provenance.method: Independent centreline trace. Exterior vertices are midpoints of measured thick ink (lum<80, typically 6-7 px) at corners and rakes. Interior partitions digitised from the same PNG (zoomed); hanging rails, furniture and the bathroom dashed shower line omitted. Door gaps are measured ink breaks where those exist (entrance x=99-129, bathroom y=268-298 at x=84); bedroom/storage door widths are the opening seen on the plan, recorded as along-segment gaps, not as sourced construction widths. Scale uses sourced 63 m² only.
layout_provenance.not_from: build_twobed_v4.py / 2bed.json wall coordinates were not copied.
layout_provenance.ceiling_height_m: 3.0 UNSOURCED (same modelling value as #14; floor-to-floor 3.663 m is sourced but clear height is not).

area_note: No independent scale on the layout. metres_per_px = sqrt(63.0/74115.9 px²) = 0.029155. Area residual is 0% BY CONSTRUCTION because the 3D model was scaled to the sourced 63 m². This is not an independent area measurement.
